Test_Objective: Reject an Authorization header without Bearer format.
Preconditions: Cart setup exists for a user.
Expected_Response: Authentication is rejected with 401 or 403; no protected operation succeeds.
Audit_Reason: Execution review found that the original oracle required 401, but an invalid credential may correctly produce 403 after authentication is attempted.
Correction: Allow 401 or 403 while still requiring rejection and no protected state change.
Actual_Result: HTTP 403; all automated assertions passed.

Test_Objective: Fail safely when the cart contains a stale item whose product no longer exists or is unavailable.

Test_Objective: Prevent duplicate orders when two checkout requests for the same cart arrive concurrently.
Preconditions: Login as one user; cart is nonempty; send two equivalent checkout requests concurrently.
Expected_Response: Exactly one request creates one order and clears the cart; the competing request is rejected and no duplicate order/order-items are created.
Audit_Reason: Student-designed case reviewed before inclusion on 2026-08-20. Different from CHK-AI-029 sequential retry: this specifically tests a race condition before either request has completed.
Actual_Result: HTTP 200; failed: successful checkout clears cart; server recalculates total from isolated cart.
